events.label: SixDegrees Launches
events.fact: Early social network allowing users to create profiles and friend lists.

events.label: Friendster Launches
events.fact: Pioneered social networking before larger platforms scaled globally.

events.label: MySpace Launches
events.fact: Became a major social hub with customizable profiles and music.

events.label: Facebook Launches for Colleges
events.fact: Initially debuted for Harvard students before expanding widely.

events.label: YouTube Launches
events.fact: Video-sharing platform founded by Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, and Jawed Karim.

events.label: Twitter Launches
events.fact: Microblogging platform built around short status updates.

events.label: Instagram Launches
events.fact: Photo-sharing app debuting on iOS in October 2010.

events.label: Snapchat Launches
events.fact: Mobile messaging app centered on disappearing photos and stories.

events.label: TikTok Launches Internationally
events.fact: Short-form video platform (following Douyin) expanded globally.
